method: platform page-fetch tool (fetch_page); direct bash egress to nba.com returns HTTP 000 from this sandbox, so every read is recorded with this method

schedule.name: NBA.com Schedule (official)
schedule.read: game ids, ET tip times, arena, city, state for 11/16 - 11/19, and the official finals + quarter-level scores of the 11/15 games

standings.name: NBA.com Standings (official)
standings.read: 30 clubs: W, L, WIN%, GB, CONF, DIV, HOME, ROAD, NEUTRAL, OT, LAST10, STREAK

team_adv.name: NBA.com Stats - Teams Advanced (official)
team_adv.read: 30 rows: GP, W, L, MIN, OffRtg, DefRtg, NetRtg, AST%, OREB%, DREB%, TOV%, eFG%, TS%, PACE, PIE, POSS

team_opp.name: NBA.com Stats - Teams Opponent (official)
team_opp.read: 30 rows: Opp PTS (points allowed per game) and the opponent +/- column

team_trad.name: NBA.com Stats - Teams Traditional (official)
team_trad.read: 30 rows: PTS, FGM/A, FG%, 3PM/A, 3P%, FTM/A, FT%, OREB, DREB, REB, AST, TOV, STL, BLK, PF, +/-

injury_index.name: NBA Official - Injury Report index (official)
injury_index.read: the filing deadlines and the list of every published release; the newest indexed release at retrieval was 11/16/26 09:15 AM ET

injury_binary_pdf.what: The injury PDFs as stored bytes
injury_binary_pdf.why: The page-fetch tool returns the PDF's text, not its bytes, and bash egress to ak-static.cms.nba.com is blocked (HTTP 000). Every release this session therefore carries its official URL, its revision stamp and this session's retrieval stamp, plus a sha256 of the transcribed text (a content hash), but NOT the original file hash. Flagged F-V4-01; the fix is a runner with network access, not a guess.

player_game_logs.what: Per-player game logs for the 11/15 and 11/16 games
player_game_logs.why: Gamebook box scores for 11/15 are reachable and their team/period rows were read, but transcribing 9 games x ~26 player rows was outside this session's budget. The committed 11/13 and 11/14 logs stand unchanged; the gap is published, not filled. Flagged F-V4-02.

arena_coordinates_official.why: NBA.com publishes arena name, city and state but no coordinates. The coordinates used for travel distance are THIRD-PARTY (Wikipedia/Wikidata geocodes, captured 2026-11-15) and are labelled that way on every row that uses them. Flagged F-V4-03.

closing_lines.why: No licensed odds feed is connected (gate G6). Without a closing line the market-anchored prior's weight is undefined, so w_market stays blank and the blended line is not published. Flagged F-V4-04, carried from v3.
